learning_outcomes.text: Gain insights into operational and university working methods and social structures.
Learn design, conception, and development methods, as well as process and operational tasks in electrical engineering and information technology.
Acquire communicative and social key qualifications through interaction with supervisors and team members.
Master the preparation of a scientific project report.

syllabus_topics: Development, computer-aided design, program development under industrial conditions
Project planning, production preparation, documentation, testing
Manufacture of components, printed circuit boards, circuits
Installation and commissioning of devices, machines and systems
Quality assurance, production control, reliability analysis
assessment_rules: Credits are awarded for successfully completing the practical project and passing the report. The final grade of this module does not contribute to the overall final grade (0/138).
